practical_interpretation: About 54 degrees; roughly 50–58 is a working systematic bracket, not a statistical confidence interval. The previous 51.5/52-degree cameras remain compatible with this study.
assumptions: Orthographic or weak perspective; selected edges assumed circular and horizontal.
method: Minimize weighted mean squared approximate orthogonal edge residual, with separate ellipse centers/radii for each feature and a shared minor/major ratio sin(elevation). A full ring carries weight 1; partially hidden front arcs weight 0.25. Weights are explicit engineering choices, not statistical inverse variances.

traces.feature: Top battlement rim crest; several separated visible sectors
